descripcion: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.6 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to read Kubernetes Secrets from other namespaces in clusters connected through the GitLab agent for Kubernetes due to incorrect authorization in workspaces. 17/11/2026 17/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.60 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

The Everest Backup – WordPress Cloud Backup, Migration, Restore & Cloning Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.14 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to activate any already-installed inactive plugin on the site. 17/11/2026 17/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM
